claims.statement: Pact consumer tests execute a real API client against Pact's generated mock server and write expectation interactions as a Pact contract file.
claims.locator: Contract Testing Process (HTTP), Consumer API and Example
claims.rationale: Pact JS documentation defines the consumer mock test and output pact file.

claims.statement: The Pact Verifier replays contract interactions against a locally running provider and fails when expected types or responses do not match.
claims.locator: Provider Verification / Provider API Testing / Verification Options
claims.rationale: The official JS guide defines Verifier and pactUrls for provider verification.

claims.statement: Consumer-driven contracts express the outbound expectations of consumer code, not every possible OpenAPI response or backend feature.
claims.locator: Consumer Tests / Example and Contract Testing Process (HTTP)
claims.rationale: The Pact JS consumer guide recommends exercising the real API client against the mock provider.

claims.statement: RFC 9457 defines a structured problem-details JSON representation with type, title and status values.
claims.locator: Section 3.1 Members of a Problem Details Object
claims.rationale: The RFC specifies the three error fields used in the consumer expectation.
